title: Wrigley Mailed Free Gum to a Million Strangers
description:
Wrigley didn't start in gum. He started in soap — and gave away free baking powder to sell it.

When the baking powder outsold the soap, he switched to selling that. Then he gave away free gum with the baking powder — and the same thing happened again. In 1915, he mailed free gum, unsolicited, to about 1.5 million homes listed in US phone books, figuring anyone who could afford a phone could afford gum. He repeated it in 1919 to roughly 7 million homes.
